counter.name: Counter
counter.title: The counter
counter.note: Builders' merchants and kitchens were running on paper chits and memory. I shipped POS registers, stock-controlled inventory and back offices that share one source of truth.
counter.hint: Tap stock to ring it up, then charge and print.

laundry.name: Laundry
laundry.title: Every garment,
laundry.note: Tickets at An-Nur's laundry counter went missing between washing and pressing. Now every order gets a code, moves through workstation stages and is scanned out at collection.
laundry.hint: Drop off the bag, start the cycle, then tell the customer.

analyst.title: Run the numbers
analyst.note: I have evaluated 50+ SMEs for investment and built decision tools for Islamic finance and women-led capital. A model has to survive a bad year, not just look good in a good one.
analyst.hint: Pick a tenor, then push rates up after month 6.
